mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals improving labor market conditions, which increases consumer confidence and spending, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in housing starts below 1.2 million units signals weakening consumer demand and reduced confidence in the broader economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 85.0 (2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reflecting weak demand and supply chain disruptions, which depresses corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in CPI inflation above 3.0% signals a central bank's attempt to stimulate the economy amid persistent inflation, which increases real rate uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rebound in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) following a prior contraction signals a recovery in consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1.5% MoM after two consecutive monthly declines
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 65% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and decline in the unemployment rate signals strong labor market tightening, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 0.5% annualized growth signals a deepening recession, which triggers risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained zero or negative federal funds rate combined with rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals a liquidity trap, where monetary policy loses effectiveness and equity valuations become vulnerable to future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 58% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.
